entries.jp: {spd:09000000} 比紀弾正は五丈軍を名乗り{br}{skip:0100}北天を席捲した{end}
entries.en: {spd:09000000} Danjo Hiki named his army Gojo{br}{skip:0100}and swept across the northern heavens.{end}

entries.jp: 狼刃の四軍団は{br}{skip:0100}無敵を誇り もはや銀河統一も目前と{br}{skip:0100}噂されるところであった{end}
entries.en: and Roha led four{br}{skip:0100}invincible legions, and the galaxy's{br}{skip:0100}unification was said to be at hand.{end}

entries.jp: {skip:0400}しかし 隆盛を誇った弾正も{br}{skip:0400}老いには勝てず{br}{skip:0400}病に倒れる事一ケ月{br}{skip:0400}享年七十四才にて逝去{br}{skip:0400}これにより 銀河は今一度{br}{skip:0400}麻のように乱れる事は{br}{skip:0400}誰の目にも明らかであった{end}
entries.en: {skip:0400}But even Danjo in all his glory{br}{skip:0400}could not overcome old age.{br}{skip:0400}A month after falling ill,{br}{skip:0400}he passed away at seventy-four.{br}{skip:0400}And so it was plain to all{br}{skip:0400}that the galaxy would once more{br}{skip:0400}fall into utter chaos.{end}

entries.jp: {skip:0100}弾正の死後{spd:01000800} 最初に動いたのは{br}{skip:0100}車騎元帥・骸羅であった{end}
entries.en: {skip:0100}After Danjo's death,{spd:01000800} the first to move{br}{skip:0100}was Gaira, the Chariot Marshal.{end}

entries.jp: {skip:0100}電撃作戦により 武王都を占{spd:03000000}拠{br}{skip:0100}大元帥・鳳鳴{spd:02000000}、驃騎元帥・玄偉を葬{spd:02000000}り{br}{skip:0100}衛元帥・狼刃と共謀{end}
entries.en: {skip:0100}Seizing Buoto in a lightning war,{br}{skip:0100}he slew Marshals Homei and Geni{br}{skip:0100}and conspired with Marshal Roha.{end}

entries.jp: {skip:0100}都を斎王都へと移し{br}{skip:0100}国名を大五丈と号した{end}
entries.en: {skip:0100}He moved the capital to Seioto{br}{skip:0100}and named his nation Great Gojo.{end}

entries.jp: 骸羅「わはははは{spd:02000000} 天よわめけ{spd:02000000}!{br}{skip:0300}泣き叫ぶがよい!」{end}
entries.en: Gaira "Wahahaha!{spd:02000000} Howl, O heaven!{spd:02000000}{br}{skip:0300} Weep and wail!"{end}

entries.jp: 骸羅「お前がどうあがこうと{br}{skip:0300}この世はわしのものだ!」{end}
entries.en: Gaira "No matter how you struggle,{br}{skip:0300} this world is mine!"{end}

entries.jp: 骸羅「やがて天をも{br}{skip:0300}わしが支配してやる!」{end}
entries.en: Gaira "In time I'll rule{br}{skip:0300} even the heavens!"{end}

entries.jp: 骸羅「わしは大銀河の皇帝なのだ!」{end}
entries.en: Gaira "I am Emperor of the great{br}galaxy!"{end}
